description: Retrieves data for a Figma Design file or selected nodes, with options to specify a version and limit tree depth. By default it returns a simplified view that omits invisible nodes and empty values; choose full detail for the raw Figma response. Use node IDs and depth to reduce response size for large files.

inputSchema.description: Request schema for GetFileJson with simplification options.

depth.description: Tree traversal depth (e.g., 2 for pages and top-level children). Omitting depth on large files can produce extremely large responses or timeouts; scope with `ids` and set depth to the minimum needed.
depth.title: Depth

file_key.description: File key extracted from a Figma Design file URL. SUPPORTED: figma.com/design/{file_key}/... or figma.com/file/{file_key}/... NOT SUPPORTED: FigJam boards (figma.com/board/{file_key}) and Slides (figma.com/slides/{file_key}). Example valid key: 'abc123XYZ' from URL figma.com/design/abc123XYZ/My-Design.
file_key.title: File Key

geometry.description: Set to "paths" to include vector data
geometry.title: Geometry

ids.description: Comma-separated node IDs to fetch specific nodes (uses /nodes endpoint). Node IDs can be extracted from Figma URLs: figma.com/design/{file_key}/{name}?node-id={node_id}. Example: '1:2,1:3' for multiple nodes. Must be a string, not an array — passing an array causes validation failure. URL node IDs use hyphens (e.g., '1-2'); convert to colons (e.g., '1:2') before passing here.
ids.title: Ids

plugin_data.description: Comma-separated plugin IDs to include plugin data
plugin_data.title: Plugin Data

response_detail.description: Level of detail in the response. 'minimal' (default) simplifies file data for AI consumption. 'full' returns the raw Figma API response.
response_detail.title: Response Detail

version.description: Specific version ID; current version if omitted
version.title: Version
